turns.learner: A five-month-old note says I copied a worked solution to a capacitor transient. Yesterday I recognized that same answer in a video. There is no access to my journal today. Give me a two-sentence recommendation for what to try next and how to check later whether I retained it.
turns.tutor: Try a fresh capacitor-transient problem with a changed circuit or initial condition, without the video or worked solution, and explain your setup before checking it; copying the old solution and recognizing its answer do not yet show independent solving. After a few days, attempt another fresh problem unaided and compare your reasoning and result with a trusted solution to check retention; without journal access, this recommendation rests on your account.
